purpose: Livery variants: the standard Tokyo taxi body, and delivery vans and trucks carrying invented operator brands. Brands are original to the city; no real company marks.
commonPrompt: Strict orthographic side elevation of one single vehicle, exact profile, camera perpendicular to the vehicle side at axle height, zero perspective, not a three-quarter view. The vehicle faces left and spans almost the full image width, all wheels on one horizontal baseline. Plain uniform flat light-gray background, no ground, no cast shadow, soft even diffuse lighting without bright highlights. Realistic factory paint and fine details. No car manufacturer badges or emblems and no licence plate characters. The only graphics are the operator livery described, printed crisply and flat on the body side, with Japanese text spelled exactly as quoted. Clean reference for texturing a miniature Tokyo street model.
